sos_alert.title: SOS Alert
sos_alert.description: Real-time emergency SOS alert broadcast by students with live telemetry

sos_id.description: Unique identifier for the SOS alert

user_id.description: Identifier of the student who triggered the alert

user_name.description: Full name or roll number of the student

status.description: Current lifecycle status of the SOS alert

battery_level.description: Device battery percentage (0-100) captured and updated in real-time

is_charging.description: Whether the device is currently plugged into a power source

device_info.description: Real-time device battery percentage and telemetry

last_updated.description: Timestamp of most recent location or status update

location_history_entry.title: Location History Entry
location_history_entry.description: Continuous GPS location update streamed while SOS is active

timestamp.description: Timestamp when this location was recorded

/sos_alerts/{sos_id}.description: Collection of real-time emergency SOS alerts

/sos_alerts/{sos_id}/location_history/{h.description: Streaming sub-collection of breadcrumb location updates for an active SOS alert
